sources.excerpt: AfterShock Bass Distortion. The Aftershock spans the gamut of low-end crunch, from smooth and natural overdrive to full-on fuzz attack. Sale price $199.00 Add to cart Free US delivery within 5-7 workdays 2 year warranty Go to item 1 Go to item 2 Go to item 3 Go to item 4 Aftershock Bass Distortion Sale price $199.00 View details Sale price $199.00 Add to cart View details Demos https://youtu.be/1EsyFySBmXE https://youtu.be/agbCsmjTQ98 https://www.youtube.com/live/1EsyFySBmXE View All Sound Design 3 Different Bass Distortion Engines Use the center toggle to select one of three fuzz engines: TUBE (warm tube overdrive), HEAVY (high gain distortion) or FUZZ (based on Bass Big Muff). Advanced Signal Routing Choose from a range of signal routing possibilities like effects send, multi signal mixing, or mono signal splitting. CLEAN Mix Control Blend a clean signal with the overdriven signal to maintain low-end clarity and bass fundamentals. Go to item 1 Go to item 2 Go to item 3 Connect the pedal to the free Neuro software (Mac / Windows) or Neuro Mobile App (iOS / Android) to download, customize, and share effects for your One Series pedal Increase Your Pedal Functionality 10x with Neuro 3 Windows Mac Intel Mac Silicon Google Play App Store About Neuro 3.0 Aftershock Bass Distortion Features Store Up To 6 Different Overdrives The center toggle offers six slots arranged as two banks of three. Bank 1 (green) works like a standard pedal, with sounds reflecting the current knob positions. Bank 2 (red) provides three preset slots, where each sound loads with fixed settings. Stereo I/O Distort upstream stereo signals, split a mono signal to dual outputs, or use the additional in and out as an external effects loop. Universal Bypass™ Select between high-quality signal relays for true bypass and transparent buffers for analog bypass. Preset Saving Save up to 6 effect presets. External Expression Control Connect the Neuro Hub to any TRS (Tip Hot) expression pedal for on-the-fly control of any adjustable parameter.
